title: rConfig Core 8.0.0 before 8.2.13 and rConfig Pro before 8.4.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability in the…
description: rConfig Core versions before 8.2.13 and rConfig Pro versions before 8.4.0 have an authorization bypass vulnerability in the users API. This flaw allows authenticated users to modify other user accounts, including administrators, by sending crafted update requests. Exploiting this vulnerability enables attackers to change an administrator's password and gain full control of the system.
